title: bandolier down output
description: What `bandolier down` stopped. Data always persists. cli-spec.md §6 (Projects).

was_running.description: False when down was an idempotent no-op (§2).

data_kept.description: `down` never removes volumes; only delete --purge and volumes rm do.

handoff_path.description: Where the handoff note was written (cli-spec.md §12), or null when none was — nothing to describe, --no-handoff, or the write failed. Additive since Phase 9.

handoff_summarised.description: True when the agent's own summary made it into the note, false when it holds the repository state alone.
